A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose an algorithm for MDE, which is based on a novel semi global optimization technique that can improve classification based MDE methods by a significant factor, without increasing the computation time by more than a few ms.

we propose a semi global optimization for classification-based monocular depth estimation, that can be applied to all classification based monocular methods, and can be easily implemented in real-time.
we propose an optimization method to enhance MDE results by using a semi global stereo cost volume, which is generated by transforming the last layer feature vectors of a classification based MDE.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, by combining the power of deep neural networks with a classical optimization method we can obtain more accurate depth maps, while at the same time keeping a reasonable computational cost.
the proposed semi global stereo optimization can be applied as a post processing step for MDE, enhancing results with a small additional cost in terms of time.
the use of geometric information can be beneficial for monocular depth computation, even if the information is not directly used during the training process.
